entities.name: Query protein 556 aa
observations: Sequence length 556 aa; estimated molecular mass 61.47 kDa; theoretical pI 8.97; predicted net charge at pH 7 is +9.96.
Contains a Pfam PFK domain (PF00365.26) spanning residues 77–450.
Near-full-length homologs Q9EZ02, P70826, and O83553 are reviewed PPi-dependent 6-phosphofructokinases with 52.4–58.4% identity and 97.2–99.1% coverage.
Function is inferred from strong homology and domain evidence; exact substrate specificity is not independently established for this sequence.

entities.name: Q9EZ02
observations: Catalyzes beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + diphosphate = beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate + phosphate + H+.
Requires Mg2+; reported as a cytoplasmic homodimer and non-allosteric enzyme.
Homology to query: 58.4% identity, 98.9% query coverage, E-value 2.56e-224.
